name: agent-snap
description: Zero-impact git working-tree snapshots for AI agent sessions (Go core + Pi/OpenCode connectors)

scripts.typecheck: bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p packages/pi && bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p packages/opencode && bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:node: bun run build && node --import tsx --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/pi/test/*.test.ts
